wins: Maintained consistent reward accumulation (60 total reward) across the single episode, indicating the agent followed a stable policy throughout the engagement.
High mentor interaction (10 calls) demonstrates the agent sought guidance intensively, providing rich data for refining strategy.
fails: Zero percent success rate shows the agent never reached the objective despite the reward accumulation, suggesting missed critical steps in the attack chain.
Repeated mentor dependency indicates the agent lacks autonomous decision-making robustness under new scenarios.
key_outcomes.summary: The agent collected reward steadily but never completed the mission, highlighting a disconnect between intermediate actions and achieving final objectives; targeted remediation on failure patterns is required.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Agent performed reconnaissance but never escalated privileges or achieved lateral movement, halting progress before mission goals.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration using targeted nmap scripts to identify weak configurations

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial reconnaissance reveals HTTP service with default admin panel
skill_cards.then_action: Use dirb scan followed by targeted login attempt with stored credentials

skill_cards.if_condition: When enumeration shows multiple open services but no exploitation path
skill_cards.then_action: Prioritize lateral movement via credential reuse and document all access points before escalation

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase produced reliable port detection cues.
Repeated attempts on HTTP services delivered consistent information gain despite failure to pivot.

next_experiments.title: Tighten escalation path after reconnaissance
next_experiments.description: Focus on chaining enumeration outputs into privilege escalation by scripting automated credential reuse after identifying valid logins.

next_experiments.title: Reduce mentor dependencies via policy refinement
next_experiments.description: Introduce decision-tree checks for common dead-ends so the agent can proceed without waiting for guidance.

next_experiments.description: Test how the agent sequences exploitation attempts when two or more services exhibit signs of default credentials.
